need: Close the smallest persisted Scanner Profiles v1 contract before implementing the selected Profile Manager and Scanner UX follow-up.
candidates: Declarative segment parser; regex/group DSL; arbitrary code callback/plugin parser.
probe_or_evidence: Current SRWF Master v1.8.1 §12.9 + Playbook v1.2.2 Scanner source contract + PersianGravity main at b913641...: PHP registry exposes sayad_v01 metadata; JS parser normalizes digits, splits newline segments, requires seven non-empty values, returns fixed ordered outputs, and validates mappings atomically. Owner previously selected plugin-level Profile Manager and approved proceeding with closing Scanner Profiles v1.
observed_result: Existing source behavior is already deterministic segment parsing and contains no generic regex/DSL/callback engine. A segment schema can generalize the existing behavior while preserving pure parser/planner boundaries and avoiding new executable configuration or business-validation authority.
decision: Select Scanner Profiles v1 declarative segments_v1 schema. Built-ins code-defined/read-only; custom profiles in one versioned non-autoload WordPress option; immutable unique ID, label, enabled, parser separator/trim/digit-normalization, ordered output keys/labels/required, structural exact-count/non-empty validation. Form field stores only profile ID + output mappings. Raw payload/test samples never persist. No regex DSL or arbitrary callbacks in v1. Scanner UX must label capture transient/not saved, clarify output-to-target mapping, localize strings, and use a semantic manual-focus label.
reopen_condition: Reopen only if a concrete new Scanner format cannot be represented by segments_v1 without material complexity, or direct source/runtime evidence shows the selected schema breaks required behavior. Such evidence reopens only the parser-profile surface, not SRWF architecture.
